svg.title: Workflow engine: components and ownership
svg.desc: Trigger surfaces call WorkflowService.start with a definition from the registry; the executor walks the definition and delegates to host-side runners, context and gate evaluation, the workflow git lifecycle and the task layer, persisting after every step. Git and turn dispatch reach the server only through WorkflowTurnAdapter callbacks.

g.text: Hover a component for its role and code; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Surfaces start runs; the executor persists after every step and reaches git and providers only through injected ports and the task layer.

g.text: JSON API · run form · GitHub webhook · workflow_run MCP tool · CLI
Trigger surfaces · every server-managed surface resolves a WorkflowDefinition and calls WorkflowService.start
The connected CLI is an API client; the standalone CLI calls the same method on a headless runtime (DartclawRuntime.stageHeadless).
WorkflowRegistry · built-ins from <dataDir>/workflows/built-in/, custom from workflows/custom/
Invalid files are recorded in exclusions, and a materialized name wins a clash with a custom one.
WorkflowService · start validates variables, snapshots the definition into definitionJson, inserts the run, spawns the executor
One in-process section per run serializes resume, cancel, request changes, approval and timeout; it does not reach other processes.
authored-order traversal of definition.nodes; step, loop, foreach and parallel-group runners are part files
writes are conditional (updateOwned): WorkflowRunOwnershipLost stops it if the run was paused or cancelled
WorkflowExecutor · workflow_executor*.dart: starts from a step index or a persisted WorkflowExecutionCursor
Resume and retry rebuild it from the stored definitionJson snapshot, never the registry, so editing a YAML file cannot change an in-flight run.
The run row holds currentStepIndex, executionCursor, contextJson and totals; context.json under the run directory holds the full WorkflowContext.
An approval step holds the run in awaitingApproval; a bash failure is an execution error governed by onError.
Context and gates · workflow_context.dart, workflow_template_engine.dart, gate_evaluator.dart, context_extractor.dart
A step sees only the context keys it names; entry and exit gates are evaluated here and outputs are merged after every step.
Git lifecycle · workflow_git_lifecycle.dart, promotion_coordinator.dart, merge_resolve_coordinator.dart, workflow_artifact_committer.dart
The package holds the orchestration; every branch, worktree and push operation is a callback on WorkflowTurnAdapter.
WorkflowOneShotRunner · task/workflow_one_shot_runner.dart: the whole prompt chain and finalizer turn on one provider worker lease
The transcript is recorded in the task session; read-only behaviour comes from the effective allowedTools.
Task layer · workflow_task_factory.dart writes AgentExecution, Task and WorkflowStepExecution in one transaction
The TaskExecutor claims the task; the engine waits on TaskStatusChangedEvent. Task.maxRetries is 0, so only workflow retry applies.
Callbacks for start resolution, git init, promotion, publish, cleanup and availableRunnerCount keep server git code out of the package.
Provider CLI worker · reasoning and tool execution happen here only for agent steps
Project checkout · integration branch, task worktrees, promotion and publish
Worktree mechanics: task-execution-architecture.md. Git cleanup runs when a run completes, fails or is cancelled.
